comparison: Native Rust before/after only; no Python performance claim.
methodology: Five alternating fresh-process pairs/case; seven timed public calls and one untimed warmup/process; output disposal, generation, serialization and fingerprint checks outside timing. Serial CPU1, four-worker CPU1-4. RSS is process-lifetime VmHWM before verification, not incremental matcher memory.
